title: TankHead
notes: Below average but playable at any length of time. The game was unplayable at first and would randomly crash on the first launch logo, as well as, loading into a mission map and it would 100% of the time crash if trees were shot down. ".bak" was added to the end of all logo mp4s to skip directly to the menu after launch ('TankHead/Content/Movies'). The map loading issue might have been resolved through an engine update. And the tree crash issue was narrowed down to adding "fx.MaxNiagaraCPUParticlesPerEmitter=0" to the custom engine.ini file (made by copying "GameUserSettings.ini" and renaming it). It seems to disable some particle effects. Mud kickup is the most notable effect missing but gun fire, energy orbs and sparks are still present. FPS sits around 20-25. Playing TankHead in CrossOver enables DLSS upscaling and Frame injection but unfortunately I could not find a solution trying to paste nvngx.dll files in and forcing Metal. Crossover had its own performance issues that prevented a fair comparison. Using FSR frame injection in Highball causes the transparent letterbox in the main menu and in cutscenes to flicker, I found no solution to this. Other than that playing the game at 1280x832, FSR at Balanced and frame injection enabled are the best settings at the moment for an optimal experience. Last for the game to have any similarity to what the  intended look of the game is supposed to be, Global Illumination needs to be at Medium and Shadows at High. The rest can be low.
issues: Not perfect, a bit of compromises still resulting in a low fps
